title: Subsumed mutation tester; control-plane guard fails closed
summary: mutation.py is the mutation-testing tool (orchestrate mutate <module> --tests <modules>), run as a developer check on protected control-plane modules before changes land. control_plane.applies_to() now returns True (apply the guard) when the repository path cannot be resolved. control_plane.py and tests/test_orchestrator_control_plane.py are protected paths; both changed under the standing grant because the next action required them, and the change strengthens the guard.

prior_art.found: mutmut refuses native Windows (WSL required, issue #397)
